{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling any non-numeric entries
# First, inspect the revenue column to see if there are any non-numeric entries
print("Revenue values:", df['revenue'].unique())

# Convert revenue to float, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion issues
print("Number of NaN in revenue:", df['revenue'].isnull().sum())

# Check the unique values in 'channel' again
print("Unique channels:", df['channel'].unique())

# Group by 'channel' and sum revenue
revenue_by_channel = df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Display the result
revenue_by_channel"}
